name: Phishing
description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems. All forms of phishing (email, links, attachments) aim to compromise credentials or execute code.

name: Spearphishing Attachment
description: A sub-technique of phishing where adversaries send messages with malicious attachments (e.g. macro-enabled sheets, compressed files) to trigger user execution.

name: Spearphishing Link
description: A sub-technique of phishing where email links lead to credential harvesting portals or exploit kits hosted on lookalike domains.

name: Social Engineering
description: Adversaries may communicate with targets to gather intelligence or manipulate them into executing actions, such as authorization adjustments or wires.

name: Internal Spearphishing
description: Adversaries may use compromised internal email accounts to send phishing emails to other employees within the same organization, bypassing standard external filters.
